name: Submit a catalog item or order guide
intent: Submit through the catalog engine so variables, price, approvals, and request flows fire. Never insert sc_req_item by hand.

variables.description: Variable name/value pairs for the item

procedure: Resolve the item by name or sys_id against active sc_cat_item the user can see (catalog user criteria).
Describe the variable set. Collect values. Reject unknown variable names.
If the item is a record producer, call the producer API, not the cart, unless the customer standard is cart-only.
On confirm, submit via Service Catalog API / Flow. Return RITM and REQ numbers and the approval expectation.
sideEffects: submits through the catalog engine, creating REQ/RITM records and starting approval flows

prompts: Order a new laptop for me.
Submit the catalog item for more disk space on db-prod-07.
Order software X for Jane on her behalf.
